plots.title: Hourly Traffic Volume
plots.context: Bar chart of average total vehicles per hour (0-23). Peak hour is 17:00 with 181.0 avg vehicles. The overall dataset average is 114.2.

plots.title: Daily Traffic Volume
plots.context: Bar chart of average daily traffic. Busiest day: Wednesday (116.4 avg vehicles). Quietest: Friday (109.3).

plots.title: Traffic Situation Distribution
plots.context: Donut chart of traffic situation labels. Counts: {'normal': np.int64(1669), 'heavy': np.int64(682), 'high': np.int64(321), 'low': np.int64(304)}. Most common: normal (56.1%).

plots.title: Box Plot — Traffic by Situation
plots.context: Box plot showing the spread, median, and outliers of total vehicle counts for each traffic situation category.

plots.title: Vehicle Composition (Stacked Area)
plots.context: Stacked area chart showing how cars, bikes, buses, and trucks each contribute to total traffic across the 24-hour day. Cars dominate with avg 68.7/hr.

plots.title: Feature Correlation Heatmap
plots.context: Pearson correlation matrix between vehicle type counts, total, and hour. CarCount↔Total correlation: 0.97.

plots.title: Car Count vs Total Traffic
plots.context: Scatter plot of CarCount (x) against Total (y), coloured by traffic situation. Shows how car density drives overall congestion levels.
